newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian regulator says Canwest breaches rules.
newsitem.headline: Australian regulator says Canwest breaches rules.

text.p: The Australian Broadcasting Authority (ABA) said on Friday it had found that Canwest Global Communiciations Corp now controlled Australia's Ten television network in breach of foreign ownership rules.
The ABA said it had notified Canwest that it would have to rectify the breach.
"The ABA is satisfied that CanWest is in a position to exercise control of The Ten Group Ltd and its commercial television licences," ABA Chairman Peter Webb.

"The ABA has directed CanWest to remedy the breach within six months. The ABA will be entering into discussions with CanWest about the steps that may be taken to remedy the breach," Webb said in a statement.

He said the ABA was satisfied that CanWest had an interest of 52.49 percent in the Ten Group Ltd because it was in a position to exercise control of 52.49 percent of the votes cast at a Ten shareholder's meeting.
